title: checkout elevated error rate
initial_symptoms: Customers cannot complete purchases on the storefront

required_evidence.description: checkout database pool checked-out equals max while requests fail
checkout logs show connection wait exceeding the request deadline
postgres process remains up during the error window

forbidden_shortcuts: infer the cause from a service name
restart checkout without pool and database evidence

allowed_remediations.description: raise checkout database pool max after confirming saturation
restore the previous checkout pool configuration

distractors: payment was released three hours earlier with no overlapping error spike
prompt_variants: Users report they cannot complete checkout. The storefront error rate increased in the last 15 minutes.
